title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development \& Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D\&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
   

  

 For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People \& Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D\&D leadership.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D\&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D\&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow\-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include:
 * Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D\&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People \& Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow\-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D\&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D\&D, incorporating role\-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D\&D, reducing last\-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People \& Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D\&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex, multi\-participant planning cycles.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 Required Experience:
 * 7\+ years of experience in FP\&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow\-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.


 You Will Thrive In This Role If You:
 * Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive\-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow\-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.


*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI\-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
 We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
   

  

 Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
   

  

 Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Deputy Manager, Financial Operations
description:
The Advanced Specialist, Financial Operations is a senior individual contributor within Global Rights \& Royalties. The role owns complex royalty data analysis, supplier and royalty reconciliations, database integrity, advance and earnings payments, and the accurate application of agreement and product structures across multiple geographies.
 


  

  


 Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will lead payout\-based projects, make standard and non\-standard operational recommendations, and provide trusted advice on royalty processing, product structures and payment setups. You will partner with business and technology stakeholders to resolve complex issues, strengthen data quality and ensure that royalty outcomes align with contractual requirements and business objectives.
 


  

  


 You will also work closely with the Manager to monitor critical deliverables, maintain transparent progress reporting, lead quality and validation activities, prepare preliminary transaction reporting, and improve the capability of the wider team through mentoring and technical guidance.
 


  

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



  

  


**1\. Royalty Data Integrity and Calculation Assurance** 



  

  
* Analyse complex royalty data and validate the integrity of the royalty calculations database and connected operational records.
  

  
* Ensure royalty calculations, statement outputs, advances and earnings payments reflect approved agreement terms, product structures and payment setups.
  

  
* Conduct routine and risk\-based quality checks, control reviews and data validation exercises across high\-value or complex royalty activity.
  

  
* Identify data gaps, anomalous results and processing risks; assess root causes and coordinate corrective action before release or payment.
  

  
* Maintain clear, audit\-ready evidence of analysis, validation, decisions, approvals and adjustments.
  


  


**2\. Reconciliations, Supplier Accounts and Payments** 



  

  
* Lead the reconciliation of royalty supplier accounts, statements, advances, earnings and related balances, identifying and resolving discrepancies promptly.
  

  
* Maintain supplier and payment\-related records and ensure accurate, authorised and complete system entries.
  

  
* Oversee complex royalty statement and payment processing, ensuring compliance with contractual terms, operating procedures and relevant controls.
  

  
* Review unusual, high\-value or non\-standard payment scenarios and make recommendations within delegated authority.
  

  
* Escalate legal interpretation, tax, policy or commercial decisions to the accountable specialist or business owner with a clear statement of facts and impact.
  


  


**3\. Global Payout Projects and Operational Delivery** 



  

  
* Lead or provide senior specialist support for payout\-based projects across multiple geographies, from analysis and planning through validation and controlled delivery.
  

  
* Define operational requirements, dependencies, risks, control points and acceptance criteria in partnership with the Manager and project stakeholders.
  

  
* Monitor milestones, exceptions and actions, communicating progress and decision requirements clearly and early.
  

  
* Coordinate cross\-functional inputs to ensure project outcomes align with business objectives, contractual requirements and operational readiness.
  

  
* Conduct post\-implementation review and translate lessons learned into stronger processes, controls and documentation.
  


  


**4\. Advisory Support on Agreements and Product Structures** 



  

  
* Provide expert operational advice on royalty payouts, product structures, agreement terms and payment setups to support accurate processing and informed business decisions.
  

  
* Assess the operational impact of proposed or existing structures and highlight dependencies, limitations, risks and downstream consequences.
  

  
* Partner with Portfolio, Editorial, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Legal and other owners to clarify requirements and support correct system treatment.
  

  
* Distinguish operational application from formal legal or commercial interpretation and route decisions to the appropriate accountable owner when required.
  

  
* Promote consistent application of approved standards across markets, products and royalty processes.
  


  


**5\. Stakeholder, Author and** 
**OneCRM** 
**Escalation Management** 



  

  
* Provide timely, clear and evidence\-based responses to complex stakeholder, author and agent inquiries.
  

  
* Ensure prompt and high\-quality action on OneCRM tickets, prioritising material, aged or recurring escalations and driving them to resolution.
  

  
* Analyse escalation trends to identify systemic issues, control weaknesses and opportunities to improve author experience.
  

  
* Build trusted relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups and influence resolution of complex operational matters.
  

  
* Communicate risks, trade\-offs and recommendations in a way that enables timely decisions.
  


  


**6\. Technology Partnership and Sustainable Issue Resolution** 



  

  
* Partner with technical teams and business stakeholders to investigate data inquiries, system defects, interface issues and processing anomalies.
  

  
* Translate operational and contractual requirements into clear business scenarios, expected outcomes and validation criteria.
  

  
* Support root\-cause analysis, solution design, testing and implementation validation to ensure issues are resolved sustainably.
  

  
* Challenge temporary workarounds where they introduce control or scalability risk and recommend practical long\-term solutions.
  

  
* Contribute to automation, reporting\-tool development, data governance and process standardisation initiatives.
  


  


**7\. Reporting, Controls and Audit Readiness** 



  

  
* Prepare preliminary reports, summaries and analysis of royalty transactions, reconciliations, exceptions and payout activity for team and management review.
  

  
* Work with the Manager to monitor key tasks, service levels, risks, backlogs and project progress, ensuring accurate and transparent reporting.
  

  
* Maintain adherence to policies, procedures, approvals, contractual requirements, data privacy obligations and regulatory standards.
  

  
* Prepare complete documentation and work papers for author audits, internal reviews, external audits and control testing.
  

  
* Identify and communicate emerging risks or unusual circumstances, supported by impact analysis and recommended actions.
  


  


**8\. Technical Leadership and Team Capability** 



  

  
* Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance, mentoring and constructive quality feedback to junior colleagues and peers.
  

  
* Help ensure the quality of tasks, analysis and advice provided by self and others without formal line\-management accountability.
  

  
* Share specialised knowledge through coaching, process documentation, case reviews and learning sessions.
  

  
* Promote strong ownership, customer focus, control discipline and continuous improvement across the team.
  

  
* Support the Manager in prioritising complex work and building resilient operational capability.
  


  


**Essential Qualifications and Experience** 



  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  

  
* Substantial relevant experience in royalty operations, financial operations, publishing, rights administration or a comparable complex transaction environment. Experience in publishing, rights or royalties is strongly preferred.
  

  
* Demonstrated expertise in royalty or financial data analysis, reconciliations, payment processing, database validation and complex discrepancy resolution.
  

  
* Experience leading projects, workstreamsor material operational deliverables across multiple stakeholders or geographies.
  

  
* Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring to colleagues and improving the quality of team outputs.
  

  
* Strong experience managing internal and external stakeholders and communicating complex information, risks and recommendations.
  


  


**Preferred Experience** 



  

  
* Knowledge of royalty calculations, author agreements, product structures, advances, earnings payments and intellectual property management tools.
  

  
* Experience with supplier account maintenance, OneCRM or comparable case\-management workflows, author inquiries and escalations.
  

  
* Experience supporting audits, control testing, system implementation, data migration, automation or reporting\-tool development.
  

  
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with royalty, ERP, workflow, database or business intelligence tools.
  

  
* **KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

title: Hedge Accounting Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as Hedge Accounting Analyst where the role is principally responsible for monthly monitoring and reporting of segmental (head office) and statutory P\&L, and model management of certain bespoke hedge accounting activities. The team has wide diversity in responsibilities and interacts with stakeholders from multiple FTCs across the bank. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**
* Basic hedge accounting knowledge \[cash flow and fair value] would be advantageous, ideally gathered
* in a financial institution with interest rates being the key managed risk.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; tested in a variety of mediums including presentations, policy documents and stakeholder meetings/forums.
* Has the initiative and ability to break down problems into components parts and resolving them.
* Attention to detail and analytical.
* Desirable experience of linking entity results through to financial statement production.
* Fully qualified accountant.
* Degree (or higher) educated, from a top tier university.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* CFA / master’s in finance / financial engineering would be an advantage.
* Articleship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills
   

  

 This role is based in our Noida / Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To report and analyse hedging relationships, identify potential hedge accounting opportunities, and implement effective hedging strategies to mitigate accounting asymmetry risk.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and implementation of effective hedge accounting strategies that support the bank's overall risk management framework and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness and respond to changes in market conditions.
* Assessment of potential hedge accounting relationships between financial instruments, considering factors such as effectiveness, designation, and hedge ratio.
* Preparation and maintenance of comprehensive hedge accounting documentation, including hedge designation reports, effectiveness testing results, and fair value measurements and ensure that hedge accounting documentation is accurate, compliant with accounting standards, and readily available for audit review.
* Fair value measurements for financial instruments, including both hedged and hedging instruments, using appropriate valuation methodologies, and calculation and recording of hedge accounting adjustments, including hedge ineffectiveness adjustments, to reflect the impact of hedging relationships on the financial statements.
* Management of regular effectiveness testing of hedging relationships to assess whether they continue to meet the requirements for hedge accounting, and evaluation of the effectiveness of hedging strategies and adjust as needed to maintain hedge effectiveness.
* Report the internal and external statutory view of hedge accounting effectiveness for presentation into Barclays Annual Accounts.

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

title: Assistant Manager- US Bookkeeping
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 The Assistant Manager will support accounting operations, financial reporting, analysis, and client delivery activities across a portfolio of US\-based clients. The role combines hands\-on accounting with financial analysis and reporting. You will be responsible for preparing and analyzing financial statements, supporting monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, managing day\-to\-day accounting activities, performing variance analysis, and ensuring timely and accurate month\-end and year\-end close processes.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in accounting who enjoys understanding the story behind the numbers, identifying variances and trends, and translating financial data into meaningful insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Accounting Operations \& Financial Reporting** 




  




* Prepare, analyze, and interpret financial statements and financial reports.
* Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages.
* Manage day\-to\-day accounting activities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger maintenance.
* Perform bank, balance sheet, vendor, customer, and general ledger reconciliations.
* Ensure accounting transactions are accurately recorded, classified, and supported by appropriate documentation.
* Review financial data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.



  





**Month\-End \& Year\-End Close** 




  




* Support timely and accurate month\-end and year\-end closing processes.
* Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and other closing adjustments as required.
* Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate outstanding or unusual items.
* Maintain organized close files and supporting schedules.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies before final reporting.



  





**Financial Analysis \& Variance Reporting** 




  




* Conduct variance analysis to identify trends, deviations, and key financial insights.
* Compare actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and prior periods.
* Investigate significant fluctuations and prepare clear explanations for management review.
* Support the preparation of management reports, KPI analysis, and financial dashboards.
* Perform ad hoc financial analysis and research as required.



  





**Compliance \& Accounting Standards** 




  




* Ensure accounting activities comply with applicable GAAP, IFRS, and other regulatory requirements.
* Maintain awareness of relevant accounting principles and reporting requirements.
* Support audit, tax, and compliance\-related activities by preparing required schedules and documentation.
* Ensure financial records are maintained accurately and in accordance with established accounting policies and procedures.



  





**Process Improvement \& Client Delivery** 




  




* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting workflows, and financial controls.
* Participate in ad hoc accounting, reporting, and analytical projects.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and client stakeholders to resolve accounting and reporting issues.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and timeliness across all deliverables.
* Contribute to the development and standardization of accounting processes and reporting templates.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience Required** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, or related roles.
* Experience gained in a
 **CA firm, accounting firm, finance outsourcing environment** 
 , or similar accounting environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger accounting, and account reconciliations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software such as QuickBooks or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Experience working with US\-based clients or US accounting processes.
* Knowledge of
 **US GAAP** 
 and/or IFRS.
* Experience with
 **QuickBooks Online, Xero** 
 , or other cloud\-based accounting platforms.
* Experience in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, or management reporting.
* CA Inter, ACCA, CMA, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualification or progress toward such qualification.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager – FP&A
description:

This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations: you'll build the numbers, but more importantly, you'll interpret what they mean for pricing, profitability, and business direction. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a robust Excel model and presenting its implications to leadership in plain business language.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Costing, Pricing \& Profitability** 




 •    
 **Develop and maintain costing models** 

 for existing and prospective engagements, ensuring pricing decisions are grounded in accurate cost\-to\-serve data.
 




 •    
 
 Support commercial/pricing discussions with cost\-benefit analysis, margin sensitivity, and scenario modelling.
 




 •    
 
 Drive profitability analysis at process, client, client\-LOB, vertical, and delivery\-unit level, identifying margin drivers, leakages, and improvement levers.
 




 •    
 
 Partner with business teams to build the commercial case for new deals, renewals, and scope changes.
 




  





**2\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& AOP** 




 •    
 **Lead the preparation of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP)** 

 — revenue, cost, headcount, and capex planning in coordination with business and functional heads.
 




 •    
 
 Own periodic forecasting (rolling forecasts), updating assumptions as business conditions evolve.
 




 •    
 
 Track actuals vs. AOP/forecast, analyse variances, and present drivers with clear, actionable commentary — not just numbers.
 




 •    
 
 Maintain budget ownership discipline across cost centres and business units, working with respective owners on corrective action where needed.
 




  





**3\. Management \& Board Reporting** 




 •    
 
 Prepare weekly, fortnightly, and monthly review packs for management and the Board — combining financial performance with operational lead indicators.
 




 •    
 **Design and maintain dashboards** 

 that give leadership early visibility into the direction of the business (utilization, attrition, SLA/KPI trends, headcount trajectory, revenue per FTE, and other sector\-relevant lead indicators alongside financial metrics).
 




 •    
 
 Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, and framed to support decision\-making rather than just information\-sharing.
 




 •    
 
 Flag emerging risks or opportunities proactively, backed by data, rather than waiting for the review cycle.
 




  





**4\. Systems, Excel \& Automation** 




 •    
 
 Build and maintain advanced Excel models (costing, AOP, forecasting, dashboards) with strong version control and audit trail discipline.
 




 •    
 **Drive automation of recurring reporting and reconciliation processes** 

 to reduce manual effort and turnaround time, using Excel\-based tools (macros/Power Query/Power BI or similar) and cross\-functional data feeds.
 




 •    
 
 Continuously improve reporting templates and MIS structures to keep pace with business complexity (multi\-client, multi\-vertical, multi\-entity).
 




  





**5\. Cross\-Functional Interaction \& Communication** 




 •    
 
 Work closely with Operations, Delivery, Sales, and HR teams to gather and validate data, understand business context, and ensure numbers reflect ground reality.
 




 •    
 
 Present financial analysis and recommendations confidently to senior management and the Board, adapting the level of detail to the audience.
 




 •    
 **Act as a trusted finance partner** 

 to business heads — someone they consult before making pricing, staffing, or investment decisions, not just someone who reports after the fact.
 




 •    
 
 Build strong working relationships across functions to ensure data flows smoothly and reporting cycles stay on schedule.
 




**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience \& Background** 




 •    
 **Mandatory:** 

 CMA / MBA (Finance) with 3–5 years of experience, preferably within the service sector / BPO / ITES.
 




 •    
 
 Strong hands\-on experience in costing, pricing analysis, budgeting, and forecasting.
 




 •    
 
 Proven track record of preparing AOP and tracking actuals vs. plan with meaningful variance analysis.
 




 •    
 
 Experience building periodic (weekly/fortnightly/monthly) review decks for senior management and Board audiences.
 




 •    
 
 Demonstrated ability to track lead indicators and translate operational data into forward\-looking business insight.
 




 •    
 
 Experience with profitability analysis across process, client, LOB, and vertical dimensions — comfortable slicing data multiple ways.
 




**Education** 




 •    
 
 CMA or MBA (Finance) – mandatory qualification.
 




**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    
 
 Excellent command of Excel (advanced formulas, data modelling); working knowledge of automation/BI tools (Power Query, Power BI, macros, or similar) strongly preferred.

 Strong communication and presentation skills — able to tell a clear story with data and hold their own in front of leadership.

 Comfortable operating cross\-functionally, with the confidence and interpersonal skill to work with business teams who may not have a finance background.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager – Accounts
description:
**Role Summary** 





 This is a high\-ownership role for a qualified CA with 4–5 years of experience who has worked across depth and breadth in the service sector as operator / auditor and is now ready to move into an operating finance role. You will be the custodian of accounting accuracy, tax compliance, and reporting discipline for the group, while working closely with the CEO's office, business teams, and external stakeholders such as banks, auditors, and consultants. The ideal candidate combines technical depth with the maturity to communicate financial matters clearly to non\-finance stakeholders.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Accounting \& Financial Reporting** 




 •    
 **Ensure books of accounts are maintained accurately** 

 as per Indian GAAP, with working knowledge of Ind AS applicability and disclosures relevant to the group's evolving scale.
 




 •    
 
 Drive periodic (monthly/quarterly/annual) closing within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial statements.
 




 •    
 
 Prepare and review Balance Sheet reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and schedules supporting the financial statements.
 




 •    
 **Own MIS reporting** 

 — timely, accurate, and insight\-driven dashboards/reports for management review.
 




 •    
 
 Support ICFR (Internal Controls over Financial Reporting) design, documentation, testing, and remediation tracking.
 




**2\. Direct Tax Compliance** 




 •    
 **Manage end\-to\-end TDS compliance** 

 (Salary and Non\-Salary) — computation, deposit, quarterly returns, and reconciliation with Form 26AS/AIS.
 




 •    
 
 Prepare and file Income Tax Returns (ITR) for group entities.
 




 •    
 
 Coordinate and manage Tax Audits (Form 3CD and annexures) with statutory/tax auditors.
 




 •    
 
 Handle scrutiny assessments, notices, and departmental correspondence, including preparing submissions and liaising with consultants/counsel where required.
 




**3\. Indirect Tax Compliance** 




 •    
 **Own GST compliance** 

 across multiple state registrations — monthly/annual return filings (GSTR\-1, 3B, 9/9C), and timely reconciliations (GSTR\-2B vs books, e\-invoicing where applicable).
 




 •    
 
 Manage Input Service Distributor (ISD) compliance and cross\-charge/credit distribution mechanics across states.
 




 •    
 
 Lead GST audits and departmental reviews; draft and coordinate responses to GST notices and queries in a timely, well\-documented manner.
 




 •    
 
 Proactively track changes in GST law/notifications/circulars and assess impact on the business.
 




**4\. Fixed Assets \& Debtors Control** 




 •    
 
 Maintain the Fixed Assets Register — additions, disposals, capitalisation, depreciation (Companies Act and Income Tax), and periodic physical verification.
 




 •    
 **Own debtors control** 

 — ageing analysis, collections follow\-up coordination, provisioning for doubtful debts, and reconciliation of client/customer accounts.
 




 •    
 
 Work with business teams to resolve billing/collection discrepancies and tighten receivables discipline.
 




**5\. Treasury \& Banking** 




 •    
 
 Manage day\-to\-day banking relationships across group entities — operations, facilities, and documentation.
 




 •    
 
 Monitor and ensure compliance with loan/facility covenants, and coordinate timely submission of required certifications/data to lenders.
 




 •    
 **Handle Bank Guarantees** 

 — issuance, renewal, tracking of margin money/collateral, and coordination with banks and business teams on client\-mandated BG requirements.
 




 •    
 
 Support cash flow visibility and working capital coordination with the treasury/finance team.
 




**6\. Systems, Controls \& Process Improvement** 




 •    
 
 Work extensively in Tally, including cost centre–based accounting for entity/function/project\-level visibility.
 




 •    
 
 Identify and drive automation opportunities in accounting, reconciliation, and reporting processes using MS Excel and other tools.
 




 •    
 
 Maintain documentation and audit trails consistent with best\-practice control standards.
 




**7\. Team, Communication \& Cross\-Functional Interaction** 




 •    
 
 Lead and mentor a small team of accounts — reviewing work, building capability, and ensuring accountability.
 




 •    
 
 Act as a key liaison between Finance and other functions (Operations, HR, Procurement, Business Heads) to ensure smooth month\-end processes, vendor/client account matters, and compliance data flows.
 




 •    
 
 Communicate clearly and confidently with statutory auditors, tax consultants, bankers, and regulatory authorities.
 




 •    
 **Prepare clear, concise summaries** 

 and escalate risk areas proactively to the CFO/Controller with recommended courses of action rather than just raising issues.
 




**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience \& Background** 




 •    
 **Mandatory:** 

 Qualified Chartered Accountant with 4–5 years of post\-qualification experience, either with a mid\-sized corporate or a CA firm with strong statutory audit exposure in the service sector.
 




 •    
 
 Solid grip on Indian GAAP; working familiarity with Ind AS.
 




 •    
 
 Demonstrated hands\-on (not just supervisory) experience in TDS, ITR filing, tax audits, and handling scrutiny/assessment matters.
 




 •    
 
 Practical experience with multi\-state GST compliance, including ISD, reconciliations, audits, and notice handling.
 




 •    
 
 Experience with periodic closing, MIS, balance sheet reconciliation, ICFR, fixed assets accounting, and debtors control.
 




 •    
 
 Exposure to banking/treasury operations, covenant tracking, and bank guarantee management is a strong plus.
 




**Education** 




 •    
 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory qualification.
 




**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    
 
 Proficient in Tally (cost centre accounting) and advanced MS Excel; an aptitude for process automation will be valued.
 




 •    
 
 Strong communication skills — able to explain financial/compliance matters to both finance and non\-finance stakeholders.
 




 •    
 
 Prior experience managing or mentoring a small team, with a collaborative, cross\-functional working style.
 




 •    
 
 High degree of ownership, integrity, and comfort operating in a compliance\-first, deadline\-driven environment.
